doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top, rest Bot. Hero pairing: Any. Playstyle: always be on Cover-Commander, activating/deactivating every 2s to reset the buff granted at its start; don't go "hard in" until you've debuffed what will hit you next; each hit applies a -10% penetration debuff stacking up to 5 times (-50% total). A 2025-07-20 follow-up clarifies the Cover Commander buff: damage taken drops 60% immediately, decaying to 40% over time; damage dealt rises 45%, decaying to 30%; decay rate 6s. Example build: Noble Blood Doctrine, Awareness Doctrine V, Hero Damage Doctrine V, Unit Damage Doctrine V, Epic Spear Doctrine VI. Can swap to full tank (dmg-taken build or full block + CCi to reset). "Don't put" is a literal X placeholder in the OP — not fabricated here. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset — Spear Sergeants is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
